corrections:
CORRECTIONS:
(1) L1 VALUE DOUBLE-COUNT. P36's in-block move shows lp30 > 0 on public, but that gain is ALREADY in our team best: Kaggle shows max(P36, K2, #35, ...), and P36 (x138 + lp30 + insertion) is one of those files. With exp70a ~= K2 + lp30 ~= P36 + lowrefine, the gain over the current team best is ~min(lp, lowrefine effect), and zero or negative if lowrefine <= 0 on public (C3 prior: P(=0) ~0.8). Worse, the two are NOT additive. lowrefine refines exactly x138's readmit/gapfill low-detection pool (builder l.71, 1613+), and lp30 removals are 95% readmitted leaves, so they act on the same nodes. The exp60 lp30 +0.00083 was measured on x138 tails WITHOUT lowrefine or insertion. Corrected: exp70a expected +0.0000 (range -0.0002..+0.0002) over team best; P(display >= 0.955) ~0.05-0.15, not 0.2-0.3. Private: still low risk, ~+0.0001.
(2) L2/L3 LAB NOT ON THE K2 STACK. The exp60 dc0.30 arm is x138 control without insertion. div_insert.py (l.24-32) considers ORPHAN daughters of out-degree-1 parents, so a fork vetoed by dc0.30 can be RE-INSERTED by DaughterNet (p >= 0.4, cap 4) and shift the cap usage. The dc x insertion interaction is unmeasured and can cancel part of the dc gain. Note also 44b6 edge J 0.9054 -> 0.9042 (-0.0012) under dc0.30: the value lives entirely in div J. Keep the plan's -0.0010..+0.0010, but P(display >= 0.955) ~0.15-0.25 for exp70d and ~0.15-0.25 for exp70e (correlated). P(at least one of a/d/e >= 0.955) ~0.25-0.4 (plan: 0.35-0.5).
(3) L9 AMENDED (user 20:33Z governs): PAIR = {V* (public-aimed), #37 K2 56563521 (private-aimed)}. Without an eligible V*, the pair stays {#37, #38}. Keep clauses (1), (2), (3), (6) and (8), and the class-C exclusion as OUR recommendation. Delete 'the pair {V*, #37}' from (7) and '#37 leaves' from (4). State the trade-off to the user in ONE morning line: {V*, #37} loses the insertion hedge (P(insertion < 0 on private) ~0.10-0.15), while {V*, #38} keeps it; the user may re-choose. Optional (b): a 0.954-displayed variant that moved our team up inside the block at its first COMPLETE poll counts as 'best public' for the user's public-aimed slot only if it also passes (1)-(2) with 0.954 in place of 0.955. Pre-register that before any score, or drop it.
(4) TIMING. Build and push NOW (~20:50-21:00Z), not 21:05. push -> COMPLETE was ~32 min on this Saturday night (round12 dry: queue 11-12 min, run ~20 min; the K2 dummy ran ~1512 s), so ~40-50 min per dummy, and more if the account's GPU concurrency serializes the 4 dummies. SUBMIT EACH VARIANT AS SOON AS ITS DUMMY PASSES (order a, e, d as ready); do not batch at 23:30Z. Hard 23:50Z. If a dummy ERRORs, that slot is lost for 26 Sep; the fixed variant can go at 00:05Z as S4.
(5) API 429. poll.log's newest header (20:36:50Z) is a 429 on ListSubmissions, left over from the r_intel member scan. W6 must mean the last SUCCESSFUL header is < 15 min old. Tonight keep API calls sparse: one status call per kernel every ~5-10 min; fetch outputs with --file-pattern '^(submission\.csv|run_stats\.csv)$' (16 s vs 216 s for the full output; the log still comes); no LB bulk downloads or member scans before the submits. A 429 during the submit window is the biggest operational risk: start the submits >= 30 min before 23:50Z.
(6) DUMMY CHECK. The '(leaf_pruned=N)' line prints only when N > 0 (cell 7 ~l.2145-2149), so 'expect 4 lines' can legitimately be fewer. Require >= 1, plus a node delta vs the K2 dummy in (-1%, 0]. prune_weak_leaf_nodes is NOT inside try/except. It ran clean on the hidden set in P36, so a crash is unlikely, but the dummy log must have no Traceback.
(7) L5 READ RULE. The in-block signal is order-dependent: a variant moves our rank only if it beats max(all our earlier files, including P36 and the other ladder variants scored before it). Add a third state, NEUTRAL (0.954 with no move, or a move that cannot be attributed because 2 variants went COMPLETE in the same poll window). NEUTRAL knobs are neither combined nor banned. Attribution needs an LB snapshot per COMPLETE event (one CLI leaderboard download per event, ~4-5 calls in total, not every 10 min). Also move the S4 slot (L4) into the L5 pool.
(8) R8/R9 unchanged: every rung is an existing, lab-signed mechanism, so there is no new mechanism after 27 Sep 12:00Z. The retraining line is out of this ladder (and L7 shows that --set cannot swap the secondary).
